license.basis: Most Chocolate Doom-derived engine files carry GPL-2.0-or-later headers, including d_event.c. The pinned subtree and MCUME root have no standalone COPYING or LICENSE file, so that notice cannot be applied to every file by inference.
license.preservation: Keep every upstream notice intact. Do not vendor the unresolved platform/glue files or publish a derived binary until their license provenance is resolved or they are replaced with clearly licensed implementations. This repository records provenance but does not vendor the upstream source.

wadPolicy.rule: Never fetch, generate, or commit a WAD through this source-lock workflow. Game data must be supplied separately by the user outside tracked source.
